_comment: Merged by scripts/build_item_facts.py. PRICE: Serebii first, pokebase's `unlock` filling the ones Serebii prints as '??? VP'. TEXT: Smogon's Champions dex first, then pokebase (the mechanics), then Serebii (flavour). `source` and `text_source` say which answered.

Air Balloon.text: Holder is immune to Ground-type attacks. Pops when holder is hit.
Air Balloon.pokebase_text: Makes the holder immune to Ground-type moves, Spikes, Toxic Spikes and Sticky Web. Pops when a damaging move hits the holder. Consumed after use.
Air Balloon.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This balloon makes the holder float in the air. If the holder is hit with an attack, the balloon will burst.

Big Root.text: Holder gains 1.3× HP from draining/Aqua Ring/Ingrain/Leech Seed/Strength Sap.
Big Root.pokebase_text: Increases the HP the holder recovers from draining moves, Leech Seed, Ingrain, Aqua Ring and Strength Sap by 30%.
Big Root.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This root boosts the amount of HP the holder restores to itself when it uses HP-stealing moves.

Binding Band.text: Holder's partial-trapping moves deal 1/6 max HP per turn instead of 1/8.
Binding Band.pokebase_text: Binding moves the holder uses, such as Bind or Fire Spin, deal 1/6 of the target's max HP each turn instead of 1/8.
Binding Band.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This band boosts the power of binding moves used by the holder.

Black Belt.pokebase_text: Boosts the power of the holder's Fighting-type moves by 20%.
Black Belt.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This belt helps with focus and boosts the power of the holder's Fighting-type moves.

Black Glasses.pokebase_text: Boosts the power of the holder's Dark-type moves by 20%.
Black Glasses.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a pair of shady- looking glasses that boost the power of the holder's Dark-type moves.

Bright Powder.text: The accuracy of attacks against the holder is 0.9×.
Bright Powder.pokebase_text: Makes moves aimed at the holder 10% less accurate.
Bright Powder.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This glittery powder casts a tricky glare that lowers the accuracy of opposing Pokémon's moves.

Charcoal.pokebase_text: Boosts the power of the holder's Fire-type moves by 20%.
Charcoal.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a combustible fuel that boosts the power of the holder's Fire-type moves.

Choice Scarf.text: Holder's Speed is 1.5×, but it can only select the first move it executes.
Choice Scarf.pokebase_text: Boosts the holder's Speed by 50%, but locks it into the first move it uses until it switches out.
Choice Scarf.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This curious scarf boosts the holder's Speed stat but only allows the use of a single move.

Damp Rock.text: Holder's use of Rain Dance lasts 8 turns instead of 5.
Damp Rock.pokebase_text: Rain the holder starts, with a move or its Ability, lasts 3 extra turns (8 in all).
Damp Rock.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder changes the weather to rain, the rain will persist for longer than usual.

Dragon Fang.pokebase_text: Boosts the power of the holder's Dragon-type moves by 20%.
Dragon Fang.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This hard, sharp fang boosts the power of the holder's Dragon-type moves.

Eject Button.text: If holder survives a hit, it immediately switches out to a chosen ally. Single use.
Eject Button.pokebase_text: When a move damages the holder and it survives, the holder switches out to a Pokémon of its trainer's choice. Consumed after use.
Eject Button.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder is damaged by an attack, it will be switched out of battle to be replaced by another Pokémon on your team.

Electric Seed.text: If the terrain is Electric Terrain, raises holder's Defense by 1 stage. Single use.
Electric Seed.pokebase_text: Raises the holder's Defense by 1 stage on Electric Terrain. Consumed after use.
Electric Seed.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the terrain becomes Electric Terrain, the holder will use this seed to boost its own Defense stat.

Expert Belt.text: Holder's attacks that are super effective against the target do 1.2× damage.
Expert Belt.pokebase_text: Boosts the power of the holder's supereffective moves by 20%.
Expert Belt.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a well-worn belt that slightly boosts the power of the holder's supereffective moves.

Fairy Feather.pokebase_text: Boosts the power of the holder's Fairy-type moves by 20%.
Fairy Feather.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This feather, which gleams faintly when hit by light, boosts the power of the holder's Fairy-type moves.

Focus Band.text: Holder has a 10% chance to survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP.
Focus Band.pokebase_text: Gives the holder a 10% chance to survive a hit that would knock it out with 1 HP.
Focus Band.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder is hit with a move that should knock it out, it may be able to endure with 1 HP.

Focus Sash.text: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.
Focus Sash.pokebase_text: If the holder has full HP, it survives a hit that would knock it out with 1 HP. Consumed after use.
Focus Sash.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder has full HP and it is hit with a move that should knock it out, it will endure with 1 HP—but only once.

Grassy Seed.text: If the terrain is Grassy Terrain, raises holder's Defense by 1 stage. Single use.
Grassy Seed.pokebase_text: Raises the holder's Defense by 1 stage on Grassy Terrain. Consumed after use.
Grassy Seed.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the terrain becomes Grassy Terrain, the holder will use this seed to boost its own Defense stat.

Hard Stone.pokebase_text: Boosts the power of the holder's Rock-type moves by 20%.
Hard Stone.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a durable stone that boosts the power of the holder's Rock-type moves.

Heat Rock.text: Holder's use of Sunny Day lasts 8 turns instead of 5.
Heat Rock.pokebase_text: Harsh sunlight the holder starts, with a move or its Ability, lasts 3 extra turns (8 in all).
Heat Rock.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder changes the weather to harsh sunlight, the sunlight will persist for longer than usual.

Icy Rock.text: Holder's use of Snowscape lasts 8 turns instead of 5.
Icy Rock.pokebase_text: Snow the holder starts, with a move or its Ability, lasts 3 extra turns (8 in all).
Icy Rock.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder changes the weather to snow, the snow will persist for longer than usual.

Iron Ball.text: Holder is grounded, Speed halved. If Flying type, takes neutral Ground damage.
Iron Ball.pokebase_text: Halves the holder's Speed and grounds it, so Ground moves and entry hazards affect it.
Iron Ball.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It lowers the holder's Speed stat and makes the holder vulnerable to Ground- type moves even if it is a Flying type or is levitating.

King's Rock.text: Holder's attacks without a chance to make the target flinch gain a 10% chance to make the target flinch. Evolves Poliwhirl into Politoed and Slowpoke into Slowking when traded.
King's Rock.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It may cause the target to flinch whenever the holder successfully inflicts damage on them with an attack.

Leek.text: If held by a Farfetch’d or Sirfetch’d, its critical hit ratio is raised by 2 stages.
Leek.pokebase_text: Raises the critical-hit ratio of Farfetch'd or Sirfetch'd by 2 stages, so they land critical hits 1 time in 2.
Leek.serebii_text: An item to be held by Farfetch'd or Sirfetch'd. This very long and stiff stalk of leek boosts the critical-hit ratio of their moves.

Leftovers.text: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.
Leftovers.pokebase_text: Restores 1/16 of the holder's max HP at the end of every turn.
Leftovers.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It slowly but steadily restores the holder's HP.

Life Orb.text: Holder's attacks do 1.3× damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.
Life Orb.pokebase_text: Boosts the power of the holder's moves by 30%, but the holder loses 1/10 of its max HP after each move that deals damage.
Life Orb.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of the holder's moves, but the holder also loses a small amount of HP upon landing an attack.

Light Ball.text: If held by a Pikachu, its Attack and Sp. Atk are doubled.
Light Ball.pokebase_text: Doubles Pikachu's Attack and Sp. Atk while it holds the ball.
Light Ball.serebii_text: An item to be held by Pikachu. It's a mysterious orb that boosts Pikachu's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

Light Clay.text: Holder's use of Aurora Veil, Light Screen, or Reflect lasts 8 turns instead of 5.
Light Clay.pokebase_text: Makes the holder's Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil last 8 turns instead of 5.
Light Clay.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder uses protective moves like Light Screen or Reflect, their effects will last longer than usual.

Magnet.pokebase_text: Boosts the power of the holder's Electric-type moves by 20%.
Magnet.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a powerful magnet that boosts the power of the holder's Electric-type moves.

Mental Herb.text: Cures holder of Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, Torment. Single use.
Mental Herb.pokebase_text: Cures the holder of infatuation, Taunt, Torment, Encore, Disable or Psychic Noise's healing block as soon as one takes hold. Consumed after use.
Mental Herb.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder will be able to shake off move-binding effects to move freely— but only once.

Metal Coat.text: Holder's Steel-type attacks have 1.2× power. Evolves Onix into Steelix and Scyther into Scizor when traded.
Metal Coat.pokebase_text: Boosts the power of the holder's Steel-type moves by 20%.
Metal Coat.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a special metallic coating that boosts the power of the holder's Steel-type moves.

Metronome.text: Damage of moves used on consecutive turns is increased. Max 2× after 5 turns.
Metronome.pokebase_text: Each use of the same move in a row gets 20% stronger, up to double power. Using a different move resets it.
Metronome.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of a move that's used repeatedly. Once the chain is broken, the move's power returns to normal.

Miracle Seed.pokebase_text: Boosts the power of the holder's Grass-type moves by 20%.
Miracle Seed.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a seed imbued with life force that boosts the power of the holder's Grass-type moves.

Misty Seed.text: If the terrain is Misty Terrain, raises holder's Sp. Def by 1 stage. Single use.
Misty Seed.pokebase_text: Raises the holder's Sp. Def by 1 stage on Misty Terrain. Consumed after use.
Misty Seed.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the terrain becomes Misty Terrain, the holder will use this seed to boost its own Sp. Def stat.

Muscle Band.pokebase_text: Boosts the power of the holder's physical moves by 10%.
Muscle Band.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This headband exudes strength, slightly boosting the power of the holder's physical moves.

Mystic Water.pokebase_text: Boosts the power of the holder's Water-type moves by 20%.
Mystic Water.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This teardrop-shaped gem boosts the power of the holder's Water-type moves.

Never-Melt Ice.pokebase_text: Boosts the power of the holder's Ice-type moves by 20%.
Never-Melt Ice.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a heat-repelling piece of ice that boosts the power of the holder's Ice- type moves.

Normal Gem.text: Holder's first successful Normal-type attack will have 1.3× power. Single use.
Normal Gem.pokebase_text: Boosts the power of the holder's Normal-type moves by 30%, once: the first one it uses. Consumed after use.
Normal Gem.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This gem is imbued with the essence of normalcy and will boost the power of a Normal-type move—but only once.

Poison Barb.pokebase_text: Boosts the power of the holder's Poison-type moves by 20%.
Poison Barb.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This small poisonous barb boosts the power of the holder's Poison-type moves.

Quick Claw.text: Each turn, holder has a 20% chance to move first in its priority bracket.
Quick Claw.pokebase_text: Gives the holder a 20% chance each turn to move first among moves of the same priority.
Quick Claw.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This light, sharp claw lets the holder occasionally unleash a move faster than it usually would.

Red Card.text: If holder survives a hit, attacker is forced to switch to a random ally. Single use.
Red Card.pokebase_text: When a move damages the holder and it survives, the attacker is forced out and replaced by a random Pokémon from its party. Consumed after use.
Red Card.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder is damaged by an attack, the mysterious power of this card can remove the attacker from the battle.

Rocky Helmet.text: If holder is hit by a contact move, the attacker loses 1/6 of its max HP.
Rocky Helmet.pokebase_text: When a contact move hits the holder, the attacker loses 1/6 of its max HP.
Rocky Helmet.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This helmet damages any attacker that makes direct contact with the holder.

Scope Lens.text: Holder's critical hit ratio is raised by 1 stage.
Scope Lens.pokebase_text: Raises the holder's critical-hit ratio by 1 stage.
Scope Lens.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a lens for scoping out weak points. It boosts the holder's critical-hit ratio.

Sharp Beak.pokebase_text: Boosts the power of the holder's Flying-type moves by 20%.
Sharp Beak.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a long, sharp beak that boosts the power of the holder's Flying-type moves.

Shed Shell.text: Holder cannot be prevented from choosing to switch out by any effect.
Shed Shell.pokebase_text: Lets the holder switch out even when a move or Ability would trap it.
Shed Shell.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Hard and sturdy, this discarded carapace enables the holder to switch out of battle without fail.

Shell Bell.text: After an attack, holder gains 1/8 of the damage in HP dealt to other Pokemon.
Shell Bell.pokebase_text: Restores HP to the holder equal to 1/8 of the damage its moves deal.
Shell Bell.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder restores a little HP to itself every time it inflicts damage with an attack.

Silk Scarf.pokebase_text: Boosts the power of the holder's Normal-type moves by 20%.
Silk Scarf.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a sumptuous scarf that boosts the power of the holder's Normal-type moves.

Smooth Rock.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder changes the weather to a sandstorm, the storm will persist for longer than usual.

Terrain Extender.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of terrain caused by the holder's move or Ability.

White Herb.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It will restore any lowered stat in battle—but only once.

Wide Lens.text: The accuracy of attacks by the holder is 1.1×.

Wide Lens.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a magnifying lens that slightly boosts the accuracy of the holder's moves.

Wise Glasses.pokebase_text: Boosts the power of the holder's special moves by 10%.

Zoom Lens.serebii_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder acts after its target, its move will be more accurate than usual.
